summary: Swiggy's terms outline user responsibilities, platform usage rights, and liability disclaimers for deliveries and payments. The company reserves the right to modify terms, remove content, and suspend accounts at any time.

clauses.quote: We reserve the right to modify or change these Terms of Use and other Swiggy policies at any time by posting modified documents on the Platform.
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy can change these rules anytime without directly notifying you.
clauses.explanation_hi: Swiggy bina bataye kabhi bhi yeh rules badal sakta hai.

clauses.quote: Your continued use of the Platform and the Services after any change is posted, constitutes your acceptance of the amended Terms of Use and other Swiggy policies.
clauses.explanation_en: Using the app means you automatically agree to any updated terms.
clauses.explanation_hi: App use karte rehne ka matlab hai ki aap naye rules se agree karte hain.

clauses.quote: Swiggy reserves the right to suspend/cancel, or discontinue any or all products or services at any time without notice
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy can stop any service or cancel your account without prior notice.
clauses.explanation_hi: Swiggy bina notice diye aapka account ya koi bhi service band kar sakta hai.

clauses.quote: Swiggy shall have the right to remove or edit any content that in its sole discretion violates, or is alleged to violate, any applicable law or either the spirit or letter of these Terms of Use.
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy can delete or edit any content you post if they choose.
clauses.explanation_hi: Swiggy aapka post kiya hua koi bhi content delete ya edit kar sakta hai.

clauses.quote: In no event shall Swiggy assume or have any responsibility or liability for any content posted or for any claims, damages or losses resulting from use of Content and/or appearance of Content on the Platform.
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy is not responsible for any losses or damages caused by user-posted content.
clauses.explanation_hi: Content ki wajah se hue kisi bhi nuksan ke liye Swiggy zimmedar nahi hai.

clauses.quote: Buyer understands that Swiggy's (including Merchant's and PDP's) liability ends once Order has been delivered to him/her
clauses.explanation_en: Swiggy is not responsible for anything that happens after your order is delivered.
clauses.explanation_hi: Order deliver hone ke baad kisi bhi problem ke liye Swiggy zimmedar nahi hai.

disclaimer: This is information only, not legal advice. Consult a qualified professional for decisions.
